name: Personetics
tagline: Personetics reads a bank customer's transaction history to surface personalized insights, like flagging unusual spending, predicting a cash shortfall, or suggesting a savings move, directly inside the bank's own app. Its self-driving finance engine can even carry out savings actions automatically once a customer opts in. Several large retail banks use Personetics to turn raw transaction data into proactive advice instead of a static monthly statement.
